page.layout: One printed page of index text, one main column; narrow notes on the right margin edge are cut off by the scan and not legible as text. Header "INDEX" centred at top.

main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.p: convulsio num, 8.14.12.13. repletio non est causa Epilepsie, 13.20.
Respiratio qualis sit actio? 10.7. sublimis seu coacta, 11.11.
φιλοσοφος, φευματικος, φευματικος ἀλογίστως, qui morbi? 18.4.

Sanitas quid sit ex opinione vulgi, 1.5.9. 14. est quamdiu vita superest, 6.6. differt secundum magis et minus, 23.4. sive est latitudo quaedam illius, 4.7.23.4. et morbus sunt contraria, et sub eodem genere, 1.8.12. sanitatis definitio, 1.8.
Sanguis ut sit sanguis quid requiratur? 28. 20. morbos, Ib.
in Sermone quae sit pars princeps, 20.12.
Singultus est convulsio quaedam, 11.15.13. 19. cur quis facile singultiat? 5.6.
Σπάσμα καὶ σπασμὸς differunt, 13.1.8.2. σπάσμα genus vulneris est, quod et ἁλμα et φύγμα dicitur, 26.9.13.2. Spasmus quid nobis? 13.3. universalis videtur

page.notes: Scan is a page of a 16th–17th century Greek-Latin index; Greek and mixed-script words are transcribed approximately and several entries are marked uncertain. Marginal fragments on the right edge are cut off and not transcribed.
